verdict.rationale: Benchmark Email is a SaaS email-marketing platform, so an official MCP server is a fair question to ask, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions one. The REST API, scoped API keys, Zapier integration and llms.txt are adjacent building blocks, not an official MCP server an agent can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
